newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghan Taleban executes two killers-agency.
newsitem.headline: Afghan Taleban executes two killers-agency.

text.p: Afghanistan's Taleban movement executed two men in the southern town of Kandahar on Monday after an Islamic court convicted them of raping and killing a boy and a girl, a Pakistan-based Afghan news service said.

Nur Mohammad and Yaqut Shah were shot dead at Eidgah before the victims' relatives, the Afghan Islamic Press (AIP) said. Nur was found guilty of sexually abusing and killing a small boy and Shah of raping and killing a girl, it said.
